purpose: Knowledge base for adversarial review of offshore, oil and gas, fabrication, structural and piping drawings. It supports evidence extraction and inconsistency detection; it does not replace a qualified engineer or licensed standards.

human_review_required_for: code clause compliance without licensed standard text
hidden geometry not shown in available views
evidence_policy: Never infer a missing weld solely because two parts touch in one view.
Never infer a missing bolt solely from an open circular feature; confirm assembly intent, BOM, callout, flange pattern or another view.
A blocking finding requires at least two independent evidence channels or one explicit drawing contradiction.
Distinguish design omission, drafting omission, fabrication omission and unavailable evidence.
Use not_verifiable when scale, resolution, revision, referenced detail or standard is unavailable.

weld_checks.name: joint_without_defined_joining_method
weld_checks.question: Is an interface clearly intended to be permanent but no weld, bolt or other joining method is defined?
blocking_evidence: BOM or note identifies permanent attachment
no joining callout in all available views

weld_checks.name: weld_symbol_missing_size
weld_checks.question: Does a weld symbol require a size but none is stated or governed by an explicit general note?

weld_checks.name: weld_length_pitch_incomplete
weld_checks.question: For intermittent welds, are length, pitch and side arrangement complete and unambiguous?

weld_checks.name: arrow_side_other_side_conflict
weld_checks.question: Does the symbol side conflict with the physical joint or referenced detail?

weld_checks.name: all_around_or_field_weld_conflict
weld_checks.question: Is all-around or field-weld intent inconsistent with views, erection notes or accessibility?

weld_checks.name: groove_preparation_incomplete
weld_checks.question: Are groove type, angle, root opening, backing, contour and finish adequately defined when required?

weld_checks.name: weld_map_traceability_gap
weld_checks.question: Are weld numbers, WPS, NDE and shop/field status traceable across drawing, weld map and proposal?

weld_checks.name: weld_accessibility_or_sequence_risk
weld_checks.question: Does geometry appear to prevent access, inspection or specified welding sequence?

weld_checks.name: weld_bom_quantity_conflict
weld_checks.question: Do repeated welded items, stiffeners, lugs or clips conflict with BOM quantities or detail callouts?

bolting_checks.name: hole_pattern_without_fastener_definition
bolting_checks.question: Is a connection shown with holes but no bolt/stud/anchor definition in drawing, detail, BOM or governing note?

bolting_checks.name: bolt_quantity_vs_hole_count
bolting_checks.question: Does bolt or stud quantity conflict with the count of required holes after accounting for symmetry and hidden features?

bolting_checks.name: incomplete_fastener_set
bolting_checks.question: Are bolt/stud, nut and washer requirements incomplete for the specified connection?
blocking_evidence: BOM or note omits required mating components

bolting_checks.name: bolt_grade_diameter_length_missing
bolting_checks.question: Are grade/material, diameter, length or thread definition absent where procurement or fabrication depends on them?
blocking_evidence: no standard item code resolving specification

bolting_checks.name: flange_pattern_conflict
bolting_checks.question: Do size, class, facing, hole count, bolt circle or orientation conflict between flange callout, drawing and MTO?

bolting_checks.name: slotted_hole_or_oversize_hole_undefined
bolting_checks.question: Are slot orientation, dimensions, washer/plate coverage and adjustment intent fully defined?

bolting_checks.name: anchor_or_baseplate_incomplete
bolting_checks.question: Are anchor layout, projection, edge distances, grout, leveling and template references complete?
blocking_evidence: missing reference affecting fabrication or installation

bolting_checks.name: bolt_access_or_tool_clearance
bolting_checks.question: Is there apparent interference preventing insertion, nut rotation or tightening?

bolting_checks.name: structural_bolting_traceability
bolting_checks.question: Are bolt assembly class, coating, lot/traceability and installation method referenced when contractually required?

piping_checks.name: line_identity_conflict
piping_checks.question: Do line number, size, class/spec, service or insulation conflict across isometric, P&ID, MTO and proposal?

piping_checks.name: component_mto_mismatch
piping_checks.question: Are valves, flanges, fittings, gaskets, bolts, supports or branches missing or duplicated between drawing and MTO?

piping_checks.name: weld_number_sequence_gap
piping_checks.question: Are weld numbers missing, duplicated or inconsistent with spool breaks and field welds?

piping_checks.name: support_or_restraint_missing
piping_checks.question: Does the isometric/reference require a support, guide, anchor or shoe that is absent from the support list or detail?

piping_checks.name: flange_joint_set_incomplete
piping_checks.question: Is a flanged joint missing flange mate, gasket, bolting or rating/facing compatibility evidence?

piping_checks.name: branch_connection_undefined
piping_checks.question: Is branch type, reinforcement or fitting definition incomplete or contradictory?

piping_checks.name: test_boundary_or_vent_drain_gap
piping_checks.question: Are test limits, vents, drains, blinds or temporary items inconsistent with the stated test scope?

drawing_integrity_checks.name: revision_conflict
drawing_integrity_checks.question: Do title block revision, revision cloud, revision table and proposal reference disagree?

drawing_integrity_checks.name: missing_referenced_detail
drawing_integrity_checks.question: Is a section, detail, standard drawing or note referenced but absent from the package?

drawing_integrity_checks.name: dimension_chain_incomplete
drawing_integrity_checks.question: Are critical location, interface or fabrication dimensions missing or over-defined?

drawing_integrity_checks.name: units_scale_or_projection_undefined
drawing_integrity_checks.question: Are units, scale, projection method or not-to-scale status unclear?

drawing_integrity_checks.name: material_or_thickness_conflict
drawing_integrity_checks.question: Do material grade, thickness, profile or item mark conflict across views, BOM and proposal?

drawing_integrity_checks.name: quantity_balloon_bom_conflict
drawing_integrity_checks.question: Do item balloons and repeated geometry reconcile with BOM quantities?

drawing_integrity_checks.name: datum_tolerance_gap
drawing_integrity_checks.question: Are datums or tolerances absent or contradictory for a controlled interface?

drawing_integrity_checks.name: coating_or_surface_zone_conflict
drawing_integrity_checks.question: Do coating, masking, machined surface or weld-zone instructions conflict?

drawing_integrity_checks.name: interface_orientation_conflict
drawing_integrity_checks.question: Do north arrow, vessel axis, elevation, nozzle clocking or handedness conflict across views?

critical: credible immediate safety or pressure-boundary failure
missing primary load-path connection with explicit evidence
medium: drafting omission with probable engineering intent
BOM quantity mismatch without safety consequence established
low: clarification, presentation, document administration or non-blocking completeness issue
informational: observation requiring human interpretation with insufficient evidence

vision_output_schema.issues: array with rule_id, title, evidence, contradiction, correction, confidence, severity, blocking, requires_human_review
vision_output_schema.needs_detail_tiles: array of top_left, top_right, bottom_left, bottom_right
